title: Opening: recording at Angola, 12 January 1960
summary: Allen identifies the date and place, and explains the aim of asking Maxey for the meaning of slang on a work-song record.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Let me see. My voice is picking up too well. Say something Maxie, say your name.
My name is Dick Allen and we're recording Angola State Penitentiary. And you know today's day?

12. It's January the 12th, 1960. And Maxie's sitting here with his guitar playing. And we want to just get a few meanings of expressions that they use on this work song record. Some of the different slang words you use around like, what is fresh fish, Maxie?
